reception: Most of the works citing this overview have not been judged, so its reception can be read only in part. In the judged record the paper serves two roles: as a pointer to SUIF as working infrastructure — cited by work on speculative parallelism for multiprocessors and by the OlyMPIx parallelization tool as the compiler they start from — and as an entry in surveys of the field, from the ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems account of data and memory optimization for embedded systems to reviews of parallelization tools. Both roles attach to the SUIF project as a whole rather than to this paper's particular argument.
